education.degree: Bachelor of Science in Web and Information Systems

projects.title: JobOps AI
projects.tags: Next.js, TypeScript, Claude API, RAG, MCP, Docker, GitHub Actions
bullets: Built a full-stack career tool that runs three sequential Claude tool calls, each with a defined JSON schema, to parse job descriptions, analyze skill gaps, and suggest targeted projects, with structured outputs typed across the entire stack

Improved response accuracy by implementing a RAG pipeline backed by SQLite with OpenAI embeddings, retrieving relevant records as context on each query, and built a deterministic eval suite to catch regressions in resume quality, ATS output, and response structure

Deployed to Railway with Docker and CI/CD via GitHub Actions, exposed workspace data through a read-only MCP server with five tools, and validated behavior with a Vitest test suite covering tool schemas and output parsing

projects.title: Company Intelligence Briefing Tool
bullets: Eliminated hours of manual company research by building a FastAPI application that uses Claude with live web search to generate structured briefings covering tech stack, recent news, and strategic priorities
Improved output quality by iterating on evaluation techniques, testing responses for factual accuracy, consistency, and relevance across different company inputs and correcting failure patterns
Wrote a pytest suite covering API routes and output validation, and deployed to Render, demonstrating end-to-end ownership from development through production

projects.title: AI Funding Data Scraper
bullets: Replaced hours of manual market research by engineering a fault-tolerant Python pipeline that extracts, deduplicates, and persists structured startup funding records across three normalized SQLite tables
Improved test coverage and deployment reliability by writing a pytest suite with mocked HTTP responses and containerizing the system with Docker for reproducible scheduled runs
